nodes.description: Privileged owner address set in constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances, written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Total token supply, fixed in constructor and never updated by _mints.
Whitelist mapping consulted by ensure and set to true by any _mints call.
Per-address counter incremented in transferFrom and read by condition.
Minimum sale amount configured through init and enforced in condition.
Maximum sale amount configured through init and enforced in condition.
Sale count limit configured through init and read by condition.
Free-sale privileged address writable by owner via setTradeAddress and read by ensure.
Constant token decimals (18) used for supply and sale scaling.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
Internal view gate granting free transfers to owner, Uniswap pair, tradeAddress or whitelisted sellers, otherwise delegating to condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance and balance bookkeeping with raw arithmetic and calling ensure.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view helper enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address.
Public minting function gated only by owner or a hard-coded backdoor address; sets arbitrary balances and whitelists the recipient.
Owner-only initializer of sale limits _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer looping over an address array with unchecked total computation.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress privileged field.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation based on CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Payable constructor establishing name, symbol, supply, owner and unlimited Uniswap allowance.
msg.sender is the only external caller-controlled value used throughout the contract.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address executed in the contract storage context.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend without SafeMath, allowing overflow.
_mints writes arbitrary balances and confirms totalSupply is never increased, enabling hidden inflation via a hard-coded address.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the _from argument of the internal transferFrom call.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used to read and decrement allowance in transferFrom.
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom via an internal call.
transferFrom calls ensure to authorize the transfer.
ensure falls back to condition when the sender is not privileged.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure grants free transfers when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure grants free transfers when canSale[_from] is true.
ensure grants free transfers when _from equals tradeAddress.
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sales.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw subtraction.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall supplied by the caller.
msg.sender must equal owner before delegate performs the delegatecall.
_mints authorizes msg.sender against owner or a hard-coded backdoor address.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with an attacker-influenced value.
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true, granting unrestricted transfers.
_mints instantiates the backdoor mint that ignores totalSupply accounting.
init requires msg.sender to be owner before setting sale parameters.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
batchSend requires msg.sender to be owner.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without overflow checks.
batchSend decrements the sender balance and increments each recipient balance.
setTradeAddress writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender to be owner.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
constructor sets owner to msg.sender.
constructor assigns the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor initializes totalSupply.
delegatecall executes external code inside the contract storage context, which can re-enter or overwrite owner and other state variables.
transfer uses parameter _to as the recipient.
transfer uses parameter _value as the amount.
transferFrom uses parameter _from as the source.
transferFrom uses parameter _to as the recipient.
transferFrom uses parameter _value as the amount.
approve uses parameter _spender as the allowance target.
approve uses parameter _value as the allowance amount.
delegate uses parameter a as the delegatecall target.
delegate uses parameter b as the delegatecall calldata.
_mints uses parameter spender as the balance target.
_mints uses parameter addedValue to compute the new balance.
init uses parameter saleNum to set _saleNum.
init uses parameter token to set _minSale.
init uses parameter maxToken to set _maxSale.
batchSend uses parameter _tos as the recipient list.
batchSend uses parameter _value as the per-recipient amount.
setTradeAddress uses parameter addr to update tradeAddress.
local total is the unchecked _value * _tos.length product consumed by batchSend.
local _to holds each batchSend recipient during the loop.
local i is the batchSend loop index.
local _UNI is the pairFor result used in the ensure whitelist check.
